description: This Java class 'BodyDecoderEncoder' handles encoding and decoding of HTTP request/response bodies, including conversion between Body objects and ByteBufs, splitting byte arrays into chunks, and creating Body objects from byte arrays and content types.

classes.name: BodyDecoderEncoder
classes.description: A utility class for encoding and decoding HTTP bodies to and from ByteBufs, supporting chunking and content type parsing.

methods.name: bodyToByteBuf
methods.description: Converts a Body object to a ByteBuf, optionally with chunking.

methods.name: bodyToBytes
methods.description: Converts a Body object to a byte array based on its type and content type header.

methods.name: byteBufToBody
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuf to a BodyWithContentType object based on content type.

methods.name: bytesToBody
methods.description: Creates a Body object from a byte array and content type header, handling JSON, XML, String, and binary types.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a byte array into chunks of specified size.
